caption: The drawing depicts two human figures, one adult and one child, positioned centrally within a decorative, arched niche. The adult figure has long black hair, a beard, and a mustache, and is dressed in a long blue robe with red and brown trim. The figure holds the child, who is clothed in red with brown accents, on their left arm. The background within the arched area is cream-colored with red and black dot details. Surrounding the niche is an elaborate frame featuring layered, wavy lines in black and red, with additional yellow, green, and pink sections. The upper part of the frame contains stylized floral and paisley-like patterns in red, pink, black, and green, set against a light blue background. The arched frame itself is outlined with thick, undulating black and red lines, and the base of the image has horizontal decorative stripes in green, black, and rose. The drawing is executed with bold, flat colors and strong outlines.
title: Plate 35: St. Joseph: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
